definitions.explanation: A heated exchange of words between two or more people who disagree. Emphasizes the verbal nature of the conflict — shouting, accusations, and disagreements expressed through words rather than physical action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A quarrel between the two of them started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きた。
examples.english: I could hear the sound of an argument from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦くだらない→くだらない：09416_kudaranai⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}いはやめて、⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}おう→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: Let's stop this pointless argument and talk things over calmly.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb ⟦{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う→言い争う：14179_iiarasou⟧ (to argue, to quarrel). Specifically refers to verbal conflicts. Common verbs used with this noun include ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have), ⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to start), and ⟦{止|や}める→止む：01153_yamu⟧ (to stop).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言|い}い{争|あらそ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (it becomes an argument)
- {言|い}い{争|あらそ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have an argument)
- ⟦くだらない→くだらない：09416_kudaranai⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い (a pointless quarrel)
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い (a heated argument)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- けんか: fight/quarrel — broader; can include physical fighting
- ⟦{口論|こうろん}→口論：08371_kouron⟧: verbal argument — more formal synonym
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧げんか: bickering — more casual, often between close people
